set.body:
Outcome

Make neuroimaging geometry produce authoritative MeasurementFrame values without FeatureSet adapters.

Acceptance

- locus4s domain identity survives into every measurement.
- Region and searchlight are builders, not core enum cases.
- Searchlight centers and scattering information live in rendition descriptors.
- Owner mismatch, sparse centers, stable ordering, empty, singleton, and self-membership cases are tested.
- Depends on the existing NeighborhoodSystem migration rather than duplicating it.
set.title: P1.6: build volume, surface, atlas, ROI, and searchlight frames directly
